title: Non-commutativity and geometric drag
html: When the substrate parameter satisfies q(p) \neq 1 everywhere in the recursive brane tower, the comultiplication on the Frobenius--Hopf object A (quantum universe) is non-cocommutative. Consequently, the algebra \mathcal{A}_\infty (direct limit algebra) does not reduce to a commutative direct limit. Moving a vortex through J^1 \mathcal{S}_n then requires a continuous rearrangement of the \mathrm{SU}_q(2) fibre data. This rearrangement generates the inertial resistance described in mass geometric drag.
